flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmseserviceui route/route.ts, pages/Furnish/{Furnish,Landing}.ts, pages/Furnish/NoticesTable/{Notices,FurnishableNotices,PendingNotices,Column}.ts, pages/Furnish/API.ts, hooks/Auth.ts; ocmseserviceapi workflows/spcp/controller/SpcpController, auth/filter/JwtFilter, workflows/furnish/{FurnishApplicationListController,FurnishApplicationListServiceImpl,FurnishValidationServiceImpl,dto/FurnishApplicationResponseDTO}, crud/ocmspii/{eocmsoffencenoticeownerdriver,eocmsfurnishapplication}, crud/ocmsezdb/eocmsvalidoffencenotice. ocmsadminui, ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, thirdpartyapi: staff/cron/agency side, not used by the steps of this story (only the Intranet-to-eVON sync cron feeds the data, not traced)
note: Status 'Fully paid'. The flow from login to notice selection exists in ocmseserviceui and ocmseserviceapi: Singpass/Corppass landing, NRIC/UEN session + JWT, notice list per ID, checkbox and Proceed button. The login redirect step is Sebagian because the Singpass/Corppass handshake runs in an external SPCP service (cannot verify from repo). The SPCP bypass mode is only on in application-dev.properties:46. The notice list depends on eVON data synced from the Intranet; OCMS-DF-2026-067 and OCMS-DF-2026-077 (Closed, Prod deployed) record that the list was empty at one point because of the sync. Real property values and the SPCP service per environment cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Claimable for the Sesuai steps. The login redirect step is recorded as Sebagian until the Singpass/Corppass handshake is confirmed in the real environment.

steps.step: Customer opens the furnish page and sees Singpass (individual) and Corppass (business) login options
steps.detail: The furnish-particulars route loads page-furnish (route.ts:38-40). While isLanding=true (default, Furnish.ts:63) the page renders furnish-landing (Furnish.ts:513-514) with an 'Individual users' (Singpass) button and a 'Business users' (Corppass) button (Landing.ts:138, 146). Matches the story: individual or business users.

steps.step: Customer picks Singpass or Corppass and is redirected to log in
steps.detail: A click calls onFurnishSingpass/onFurnishCorppass (Landing.ts:88, 101). onPass uses the FURNISH-specific app id (getSPCPAppID picks SPCP_FURNISH_APP_ID, Auth.ts:32-33), creates a txnID, then submits a POST form to spcpWeb/ura{SP|CP}services.do (Auth.ts:121-128, 133-153). The UI side exists, but the Singpass/Corppass login itself runs in an external SPCP service: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: After a successful login, the system creates a session holding the NRIC/UEN and a JWT token
steps.detail: getAuthResponse/v1 calls the SPCP service (SpcpController.java:145). On responseCode SP200 the NRIC is read (164), plus the entityId/UEN for Corppass (172). createSession stores both in the PII temp session (199) and generateToken issues the JWT (203). JwtFilter loads userId/entityId from the session into the request (JwtFilter.java:113-114). The SPCP bypass mode is only on through spcp.bypass.enabled=true in application-dev.properties:46, default false (SpcpController.java:41-42). The real Singpass response content cannot be checked from the repo; per-environment property values cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The system shows the outstanding notices under the logged-in ID
steps.detail: When the notice page opens, Notices.firstUpdated calls APIGetFurnishNotices (Notices.ts:78-88), which POSTs to v1/furnishapplicationlist (API.ts:564-592). The controller uses the ID from the JWT session, not from the payload: UEN for Corppass, NRIC for Singpass (FurnishApplicationListController.java:80-83; the payload only allows status/$limit/$skip, lines 31-33). The service loads offender records (offender_indicator='Y') from the owner_driver table with the decrypted id_no (FurnishApplicationListServiceImpl.java:84-85; EocmsOffenceNoticeOwnerDriverRepository.java:50-59), then matches them to eVON for notices that are still outstanding (119-131). Note: tickets OCMS-DF-2026-067 and OCMS-DF-2026-077 (Closed, Prod deployed) record that the list was empty at one point because eVON was not synced from the Intranet; eVON data depends on the sync cron, the real state cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: Customer selects one or more notices and moves on to fill in the particulars
steps.detail: The furnishable table uses checkboxes (FurnishableNotices.ts:142). The 'Proceed to furnish' button stays disabled until a row is selected (150-155). On click the stepper moves to step 2 'Furnish Particulars' and the selected notices are stored in formData (191-201; onSelected in Furnish.ts:432-441). Several notices can be selected at once, but only one hirer/driver per submission (text in FurnishableNotices.ts:102-104).
